Desktop Liquid Security Inspector FC1500B

Dimensions: 460mm(W) x 367mm(D) x 260mm(H)
Detectable Vessel Size: Diameter 30mm-200mm (Glass, Plastic, Ceramic)
Non-radiative and eco-friendly microwave detection; identifies over 30 hazardous liquids including gasoline and concentrated acids; world-leading 0.5s detection speed for non-metal containers; unique bottom-of-container analysis technology.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC1500B Desktop Liquid Security Inspector is an eco-friendly and high-efficiency security screening device. It utilizes ultra-wideband pulsed microwave reflection and thermal conductivity methods, containing zero radiation and ensuring no harm to human health or inspected items. This detection method is both environmentally friendly and highly secure. The equipment is widely used in rail transit, large-scale events, and critical venues for rapid and accurate detection of flammable, explosive, and corrosive hazardous liquids. Its unique 'bottom-of-container' detection technology allows for precise analysis even when minimal liquid remains in the vessel.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • Non-contact, non-opening detection: identifies hazardous liquids through sealed containers without opening, safe and fast.
  • Broad applicability: detects flammable, explosive, corrosive, and toxic liquids in glass, plastic, ceramic, and other non-metallic containers.
  • Wide container compatibility: supports various container wall thicknesses from 1-10mm.
  • Rapid detection: single test completes within 2 seconds.
  • Intuitive result display: large color LCD screen with clear pass/alarm indication and audio-visual alerts.
  • Automatic calibration: built-in self-calibration function to ensure measurement accuracy.
  • Portable design: compact and lightweight, suitable for checkpoint and mobile inspection use.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
TechnologyUWB Pulse Microwave Reflection & Thermal Conductivity
Hazardous Categories32+ types of flammable, explosive, and corrosive liquids (inc. dilute acids)
Detection SpeedNon-metal: 0.5s (avg); Metal: 7.5s (avg)
Container SupportIron, Aluminum, Plastic, Glass, Ceramic, etc.
Detection MethodExclusive bottom-of-vessel scanning
Storage≥100,000 records; CSV/Analysis export via USB
Alarm ModesRed/Green LEDs, high-decibel buzzer, LCD messages
Power Consumption10W (Ultra-low consumption)
Weight≤9kg
Dimensions460mm x 367mm x 260mm
